label: Astro Bun (3D: a bunny astronaut bounds round the card, flips on its jetpack and brings the letter)

preset.title: Astro Bun Lands
preset.intro: Lay the card flat, point your phone at it, and watch for a landing.
body: Mission control, this is Astro Bun. I flew past three moons and one very confused comet to bring you this.
Happy birthday. Of all the planets out there, yours is my favourite place to land.

groups.title: The board
groups.note: The words on the board that springs up while Astro Bun cheers. Up to about 40 letters; longer words get smaller.

rows.label: Board
rows.value: Sinh nhật vui vẻ, phi hành gia!
